title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Check that every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket in the correct order.

input.hint: JSON object: { text: string made only of ( ) [ ] { } }

approach.explanation: Brackets must close in the reverse order they opened, which is exactly how a stack behaves (last in, first out). Push every opening bracket. When a closing bracket appears, the most recent unmatched opening bracket must be on top of the stack and must be the same type; otherwise the string is invalid. After the last character the stack must be empty, or some opening bracket was never closed.
